name: worksheet-universe
description: Next.js teacher worksheet console and JSON-first worksheet compiler prototype.

scripts.dev: env TMPDIR=/tmp TMP=/tmp TEMP=/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp next dev
scripts.build: env TMPDIR=/tmp TMP=/tmp TEMP=/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp next build --webpack
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.test: env TMPDIR=/tmp TMP=/tmp TEMP=/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp node --import tsx --test tests/**/*.test.ts
